description: Change of Use from mixed commercial/residential use to a single residential dwelling, including an L-shaped dormer extension to create a 4 bedroom dwelling.
decision_conditions:
<p>No development shall commence until an energy strategy has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority demonstrating&nbsp;Minimum 35% improvement 
against Part L 2021 on site.&nbsp; The details shall include:</p><p>-Merton's Energy Assessment Template for Minor 
Residential Schemes</p><p>-‘As Designed’ Internal Water Use 
Calculations </p><p>-Plans showing the location of the 
proposed heating system, any renewable 
technologies and any thermal and/ or 
battery storage</p><p>-'As Designed' SAP outputs– including 
compliance reports and TER/DER8 
worksheets</p><p><br></p><p>Reason: To comply with Merton Local Plan policies CC2.1-CC2.6.</p>

<p>The development shall not be occupied until evidence to demonstrate that the development has delivered the energy savings set out in the approved Energy Strategy pursuant to condition 8. The submitted details shall include:</p><p>- An Updated Energy Assessment Template 
(see ‘As Built Stage’ tab) - ‘As Built’ Internal Water Use Calculations</p><p>- ‘As Built’ SAP outputs</p><p>-MCS9 certificates and photos of all 
installed renewable energy technologies 
(e.g. solar PV, heat pumps, etc.)&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>Reason: To comply with Local Plan policies CC2.1-CC2.6.&nbsp;</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Sustainable Drainage</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - The development shall not be occupied until the all flood and drainage measures outlined in the approved Flood Risk Assessment by&nbsp;</span></span>MATTIX LIMITED have been implemented in full.&nbsp;</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="line-height: 107%;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">: To ensure satisfactory means of surface water
drainage, to reduce the risk of flooding and to comply with the following
Development Plan policies for Merton: policy SI 13 of the London Plan 2021 and
policies F15.7, F15.8 and F15.9 of the Local Plan 2024.</span></span><o:p></o:p></p><p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:" arial",sans-serif;="" mso-fareast-font-family:aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:="" en-gb;mso-fareast-language:en-us;mso-bidi-language:ar-sa"=""><br></span></p>

Sustainability (Water Consumption) - No part of the development hereby approved shall be occupied until evidence has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority confirming that the development has achieved internal water consumption rates of no greater than 105 litres per person per day.

Reason: To ensure that the development achieves a high standard of sustainability and makes efficient use of resources and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: Policy SI 2 and SI 3 of the London Plan 2021 and Policies CC2.1, CC2.2, CC2.3, CC2.4, CC2.5 and CC2.6 of the Local Plan 2024.

Cycle Parking to be implemented - The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until the cycle parking shown on the plans hereby approved has been provided and made available for use. These facilities shall be retained for the occupants of and visitors to the development at all times.

Reason: To ensure satisfactory facilities for cycle parking are provided and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policy T5 of the London Plan 2021 and policies T16.1 and T16.2 of the Local Plan 2024.

Refuse & Recycling (Implementation) - The development hereby approved shall not be occupied until the refuse and recycling storage facilities shown on the approved plans have been fully implemented and made available for use. These facilities shall thereafter be retained for use at all times.

Reason:  To ensure the provision of satisfactory facilities for the storage of refuse and recycling material and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies T4 and T7 of the London Plan 2021 and policy  W14.4 of the Local Plan 2024.
